launch_day_checks: Confirm TikTok public name/username can be switched to DUFYND and complete the rebrand before the first TikTok post.
Confirm Instagram and YouTube still show DUFYND branding and the intended profile image.
Set or verify each channel's stable DUFYND /start profile link before publishing.
For each upload, verify the correct final asset and cover frame on mobile.
For YSL Libre, select a current licensed/platform-native sound at publish time; do not regenerate the approved visual.
For other locked videos, preserve the approved edit and only add native sound if it clearly improves the post without fighting the baked audio.
Use the prepared channel-specific copy and do not paste a raw tracked URL into a caption expecting it to be clickable.
Request explicit operator approval immediately before the first public post.

timing_method.reason: New DUFYND channels do not yet have enough native audience history. Use current 2026 large-sample benchmarks only as a starting seed, then switch to channel analytics after the first comparable posts.
sources_summary: Buffer 2026 TikTok analysis: Saturday 17:00 is the strongest Saturday slot and Sunday 09:00 the strongest Sunday slot in its dataset.
Buffer 2026 Instagram analysis: Saturday/Sunday evenings around 21:00 are the strongest weekend slots; Tuesday 19:00 and Thursday morning are strong benchmark windows.
Buffer 2026 YouTube analysis: Shorts generally peak in the evening; Saturday 19:00 and Sunday 19:00 are strong weekend slots.
Published benchmark studies disagree in places, so timing is treated as a test variable rather than a quality gate.

measurement_after_each_post: Record native views/reach, average watch time or retention where available, likes, comments, saves and shares after roughly 24 hours.
Record DUFYND sessions by acquisition source from first-party analytics.
Do not declare a format winner from a single post.
After at least three comparable tests, adjust timing and content mix using DUFYND's own audience data.
hard_stops: No social publish without explicit operator approval.
No paid AI generation without explicit operator approval.
Do not publish the rejected old Sillage/Haltbarkeit or EDP-vs-EDT shorts.
